goal: Decide whether the intervention runner may carry out one proposed intervention on its own, so CHAOSS signals can drive the community's development without anything reaching a contributor, participant or partner that a human has not sent.

app.name: uor-intervention-admission
app.title: Intervention admission
app.purpose: Decide whether automation/interventions.mjs carries out one intervention proposed for a signal of uor-intervention-signal, from the signal, whom the act reaches, and whether Alex approved that exact proposal.

fields.name: signal
fields.means: the uor-intervention-signal answer for the chart the proposal is for

fields.name: reach
fields.means: record: the run's own CloudEvents record and job summary; agent-task: an agent-task issue in UOR-Foundation/community for the scheduled agent loop; people: anything a contributor, participant or partner reads, such as a Discord post, a comment, a label or an issue in their repository

fields.name: approval
fields.means: exact: automation/intervention-approvals.json, a trust-root file only a human-approved change can edit, approves this proposal's id; none: it does not

meanings.permit: XACML 3.0 section 7: Permit; the runner carries out the act
meanings.deny: XACML 3.0 section 7: Deny; the runner does not act, and the proposal, with its draft, is listed for Alex in the run's summary
meanings.not-applicable: XACML 3.0 section 7: NotApplicable; there is no signal, so no intervention is proposed
meanings.indeterminate: XACML 3.0 section 7: Indeterminate; unused, every request is decided

rules.why: ISO 7870-2:2023: acting on common-cause variation as if it had a special cause makes a process worse
uor-intervention-signal claims no signal without control limits

Alex, 2026-11-14: be very cautious not to overstep with contributors, participants and partners; AUTOMATION.md H1: what speaks for the organization to people is sent by a human, so the runner only drafts it
AUTOMATION.md A4: every decision is a CloudEvents 1.0 record in the run's own telemetry, which reaches no one
Alex, 2026-11-14: nothing proposed from community measurement acts without Alex approving the exact act; an agent task names a subject publicly

app.otherwiseWhy: a signal, an agent task in the community repository, and Alex's approval of this exact proposal: AUTOMATION.md A3, the scheduled agent loop investigates the assignable cause

properties.why: the runner never speaks to people
common-cause variation is never acted on
no agent task without Alex's approval of it
